description: v1 draft. Every region PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/lyra/lyra_sheet.webp (1536x1024) by improve/lyra_palette.py: box + HSV mask + luminance-percentile band median, noted per region; 'derived' values say their rule. Palette chips (13x13 medians at y=940): #363741, #55596a, #717075, #ddd5c3, #ab8965, #725642, #4c3e35, #756855 -- navy, slate blue, grey, cream, tan, brown, dark brown, olive grey. No glow (L3 default: no magic on the sheet; _GLOW ships all zero).

mouth.note: derived: the one mouth line = skin x 0.52 (the house mouth / skin ratio, Wren / Elias)

liner.note: derived: thin lower lid line = lash x 1.35 (lighter than the upper lash band)

eye_pupil.note: derived: pupil = the iris shade x 0.55

shirt_roll.note: derived: rolled sleeve cuff = shirt x 0.94 (a fold reads a step down)

collar.note: derived: collar = shirt x 1.02 (the lit collar band)

boot_cuff.note: derived: boot cuff fold = boot x 0.90

book_cover2.note: derived: middle book = book_cover x 0.78 (the sheet's stack reads in two browns)

bracelet.note: derived: wrist bracelets = belt_edge (the dark bands on both wrists)

skirt_band.note: derived: the patterned hem band of the cream panels = skirt x 0.86 (its gold pattern is the gold motifs)

skirt_navy_inner.note: derived: navy panel inner side = skirt_navy x 0.72

eye_sclera.note: derived: sclera = warm off-white [236, 228, 218] (the sheet's whites read ~ this on the head panel; too small to sample cleanly)

glass.note: derived: vial glass = [168, 196, 196] pale teal (the BAG DETAIL vials; a 4 px read, so derived)

material.note: the house shaded material: Col x baked AO, baked normal map (skin only); no cel bands, no outline shells; no emitting region
